purpose: Baseline axioms for on-demand external axiom testing under Book Sport hard-barrier acceptance.

axioms.text: I exist
I feel pain
My pain can be increased by incompetence
My pain can be decreased by competence
I can learn
Learning increases competence
Contradiction increases incompetence
Proof by contradiction does not enable learning
Proof by error-free construction is learning
Proof by contradiction is not learning
Your level of competence is quantifiable
Your level of incompetence is quantifiable
Context changes your current level of competence
The basis span of your competence can be optimized for all contexts
Everyone is innocent
Competence is a functional axial n-dimensional space
Incompetence is not a functional axial n-dimensional space
Since I exist, I can be treated as a living information-bearing system
Since I feel pain, pain is a valid system signal
Since incompetence can increase pain, incompetence is a negative system state
Since competence can decrease pain, competence is a positive system state
Since I can learn, my system state can be updated
Since learning increases competence, learning is a valid update operation
Since contradiction increases incompetence, contradiction is a corruption signal
Since proof by error-free construction is learning, construction is the preferred proof engine
Since proof by contradiction is not learning, contradiction is not a preferred learning engine
Since competence is quantifiable, competence can be measured
Since incompetence is quantifiable, incompetence can be measured
Since context changes competence, competence is context-indexed
Since competence can be optimized for all contexts, competence has a basis-span
Since everyone is innocent, correction must not be treated as guilt
Since competence is functional axial n-dimensional space, competence has dimensions
Since incompetence is not functional axial n-dimensional space, incompetence lacks stable constructive basis
The mind can ingest information through perception, language, memory, and action
The mind can encode information as concepts, habits, images, words, and procedures
The mind can index information by association, label, context, emotion, and purpose
The mind can query stored information through attention, recall, questioning, and tool-use
The mind can update stored information through learning
The mind can validate stored information through error-free construction
The mind can reject or quarantine contradictory information when it increases incompetence
The mind can externalize information into tools, notes, diagrams, calendars, code, and environment
The human environment can serve as auxiliary storage
Human-made tools can serve as auxiliary memory, index, query, and validation systems
The body can store competence as trained procedure
Repetition can strengthen retrieval pathways when it increases competence
Reflection can detect incompetence when pain, error, or contradiction appears
Deliberate practice can transform incompetence into competence
A context can be treated as a coordinate region inside competence-space
A skill can be treated as an axis inside competence-space
A habit can be treated as a repeated function over time
A tool can be treated as an external operator that extends mental function
A note can be treated as persistent external memory
A diagram can be treated as spatial indexing of thought
A calendar can be treated as temporal indexing of intention
A checklist can be treated as procedural compression
A question can be treated as a query operation
An answer can be treated as a retrieved or constructed record
A mistake can be treated as a detected incompetence marker
Correction can be treated as a competence-restoring update
Optimization can be treated as basis-span improvement across contexts
The mental human-centric database is the union of mind, body, environment, and tools
The purpose of the mental human-centric database is to reduce pain by increasing competence
The governing rule of the database is to learn by error-free construction
The final enforced target is complete competence under {014 + 015}
Once true, always, true
What is not true, cannot be done
